name: Computer Vision
short_description: Digital image representation, filtering, edge detection, object detection, and segmentation.
description: Core computer vision algorithms spanning spatial filtering, morphological operations, convolutional backbones (ResNet), object detection (YOLO), and semantic segmentation (U-Net).

courses.title: Computer Vision Fundamentals
courses.description: Image processing, feature descriptors, convolutional backbones, and object detection.

modules.title: Image Formation & Filtering
modules.description: Color spaces, Gaussian blurring, Sobel gradients, and Canny edge detection.

topics.title: Digital Images, Color Spaces & Histograms
topics.summary: Pixels, sampling and quantization, RGB, HSV and grayscale, and histogram equalization.

topics.title: Spatial Convolution & Edge Detection
topics.summary: Image gradients, non-maximum suppression, and hysteresis thresholding.

topics.title: Feature Detection & Description
topics.summary: Harris corners, scale-invariant features, descriptors, and matching.

topics.title: Geometric Transformations & Camera Models
topics.summary: Affine and projective transforms, homographies, and the pinhole camera.

modules.title: Deep Vision Backbones
modules.description: VGG, ResNet residual connections, and feature pyramid networks.

topics.title: ResNet & Residual Skip Connections
topics.summary: Identity shortcuts, degradation problem resolution, and deep feature maps.

topics.title: Vision Transformers (ViT)
topics.summary: Image patches as tokens: applying self-attention to images.

modules.title: Object Detection & Segmentation
modules.description: Bounding box regression, IoU, non-max suppression, YOLO, and U-Net.

topics.title: Single-Shot Object Detection (YOLO)
topics.summary: Grid anchor boxes, class probabilities, and intersection-over-union.

topics.title: Detection Metrics & Two-Stage Detectors
topics.summary: IoU, precision-recall, mAP, non-maximum suppression, and the R-CNN family.

topics.title: Semantic & Instance Segmentation
topics.summary: Per-pixel classification with fully convolutional networks, U-Net, and Mask R-CNN.
